chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Umayya ibn Amr, from Al-Sha'iri, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Extinguish the fires of grudges with meat and thareed.

key_terms.الثَّرِيد: A dish of bread soaked in meat broth
key_terms.نَائِرَة: Fire (metaphor for intense anger or grudge)

ai.seo_question: How does sharing food help resolve grudges according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes sharing meat and thareed (bread soaked in broth) to extinguish the 'fire of grudges' (nairat al-daghain), illustrating the practical application of *sulh* (reconciliation) through tangible generosity. This reflects the Shia emphasis on social cohesion, where material hospitality serves as a spiritual remedy for emotional estrangement, reinforcing the Prophet’s tradition of breaking bread together to restore harmony.
